This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]] [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX]] for the [[Nintendo Switch]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Spike Chunsoft]]. All names are given in Western order.
